newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Turnover in SOLIDERE shares rose in the week ended on Friday but prices were mixed with A shares falling to $111.50 from $113.5 while B shares rose to $115 from $113.

The Lebanon Invest Share Price Index (LISPI) fell 0.02 percent on the week to 84.03 and the BLOM Stock Index (BSI) rose 0.04 to 966.93 as the market awaited a $150 million SOLIDERE issue of Global Depository Receipts (GDRs) which is expected shortly.

"The market started strong and ended strong. A shares started the week on a low price and rose fractionally, while B shares remained steady till Thursday. A shares then continued to rise and B shares followed with big demand," a dealer said.
Turnover was 37,091 shares compared with 24,765 last week and value was $4,133,652.25 from $2,314,237.625.
There was no trade through the week in the other four listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Eternit, Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
